subject: small chest
text: A small chest in the underwater room contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Here you will find a small chest containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula 069
text: Gold Skulltula 069 is located behind a closed gate that can be triggered by a 360-degree spin attack or a charged sword spin.

evidence.quote: Stand by the gate, twirl your analog stick 360 degrees and press the attack button to hit the crystal, if this doesn't work then simply hold down the attack button until your sword turns orange.  Eliminate the GOLD SKULLTULA [069] here.

subject: water level
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby beside the Triforce symbol raises the water level higher.

evidence.quote: There is a Triforce symbol here, stand beside it and play Zelda's Lullaby in order to raise the water level up even higher.

subject: chest behind cracked wall
text: Blasting a hole in the cracked wall in the room where Link first met Ruto reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Blast a hole in the wall here where the large crack is and open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: barred door
text: Firing an arrow through the unlit torch unlocks the barred door on the north side.

evidence.quote: There are bars across it, but an unlit torch beside it.  Fire an arrow through this torch to unlock the door.

subject: hole in ceiling
text: Defeating all enemies in the submerged hall opens a hole in the ceiling where another Small Key can be acquired.

evidence.quote: Hitting the spikes once will make them revert to their stone form after which you can kill them easily, the shell enemies are no different than they were before.  After defeating all of them a hole in the ceiling opens up on the other side, swim up there and acquire another SMALL KEY.

subject: moving waterfall platforms
text: Platforms move downward with the waterfall, requiring Link to hook from one moving platform to the one above it before being knocked off by the water until reaching the top panel.

evidence.quote: Here's how this works, on the other side there are platforms which move downward along with the waterfall and then go around behind it underwater before popping out at the top again.  You cannot stand on them once they are covered by the waterfall it will knock you off, so your goal is to hook onto one while it's moving down and then when you get onto it, quickly hook onto the one above, and then maybe the one above that, all the way until you are able to hook onto the panel at the top that connects to the other side of the room.

subject: statue crystal puzzle
text: Solving the statue room requires lowering the water to hook north, climbing over the statue, hitting the crystal to hook east, and shooting the crystal a fifth time while on the statue head to rise up.

evidence.quote: The solution is to hit the crystal in the middle again so the water level drops and then hook onto the panel on the wall to the north.  Climb over the statue and hit the crystal in the middle again.  Hook onto the statue to the east and then hit the crystal yet again, for the fourth time.  Jump onto the statue head and while standing on it, shoot the crystal for a fifth and final time, it will rise up with you on it.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Avoiding L/Z targeting prevents Shadow Link from easily deflecting swings.

evidence.quote: First of all Shadow Link will mimic every attack that you do, so if you target him with L/Z and then keep using the overhead swing, you'll clash swords until the end of time.  What you really want to do is avoid using L/Z targeting, that way he won't be able to line up his deflection swings as easily.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Using sword stabs against Shadow Link will cause him to jump on Link's sword and hit him.

evidence.quote: One thing to note is to avoid using the stab, he'll jump on your sword and hit you every time.

subject: large treasure chest
text: The large treasure chest in the room following Shadow Link contains the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Open the large treasure chest in this room and Link will acquire the LONGSHOT, an upgrade for your Hookshot which allows you to hook onto thing which are twice as far away.

subject: blue block
text: Standing beside the blue block behind the Longshot chest and playing the Song of Time displaces it.

evidence.quote: Notice that one of the floor panels behind the chest here is different from the rest, it's one of those blue blocks you've seen before which can be displaced simply by standing beside it and playing the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down).

subject: Gold Skulltula 070
text: Gold Skulltula 070 can be grabbed from the wall near the whirlpool using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Walk up to the next whirlpool and use your Longshot to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [070] off of the wall.

subject: small chest
text: Shooting the eyeball switch opens a gate leading to a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Take a look at the wall and fire an arrow from the Fairy Bow at the eyeball switch, then jump across to grab the ledge where the gate opened and open the small chest to get a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula 071
text: Gold Skulltula 071 is located high toward the ceiling inside the central structure and can be reached using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Instead use the Longshot and aim it up toward the ceiling, off in the distance is a GOLD SKULLTULA [071] but since the reach of this thing is so good, you can get it from here.

subject: small chest
text: Pushing the block into place along the southern path leads to a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Follow the path to the end and push the block forward until it drops into place.  Make a right and open the small chest to acquire a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula 072
text: Gold Skulltula 072 is found on one of the walls in the room with the waterfall and moving platforms.

evidence.quote: This will bring you back to the room with the waterfall and the moving platforms.  On one of the walls here you will find GOLD SKULLTULA [072], make sure to get that one.

subject: block switch puzzle
text: Bombing the east and west walls allows pushing and pulling the block into the water to land on the switch and raise the water level.

evidence.quote: When they are taken care of, bomb the walls here on both the east and west sides.  Go down through the broken wall on the left side and push the block until it goes no further, go through the east side and pull it out, then go back to the west side and push it until it falls in the water and lands on the switch.

subject: timed water jets
text: Stepping on the button raises water jets, requiring Link to jump across the first jet and then the left jet before the timer drops the gate.

evidence.quote: Step on the button to raise the water jets up and jump across them, you only need to jump across two: the first one and then the left one.  Go through the door quickly before the timer runs out and the gate drops down again.

subject: Gold Skulltula 073
text: Gold Skulltula 073 is located on the wall in the rolling boulder room.

evidence.quote: Equip your Iron Boots and jump into the water after a rock rolls by, get the GOLD SKULLTULA [073] from the wall and drop down under the water below it.

subject: coloured chest
text: The enormous coloured chest behind the locked door contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: At the end of this hall, take off the boots and float up, then open the locked door here.  This enormous coloured chest of course contains the BOSS KEY for the dungeon.
